description: Prepare rolling an LP loan over: a new loan on the same position repays the running LP loan in full before its end: the position stays in its escrow, and only the difference moves, the new loan's USDG less its fee over the old repayment credited to the wallet, or what it lacks paid by the wallet. Refused above maxCostBps. Returns the next unsigned transaction; never signs.

loanId.description: The LP loan's id on the lane's core (gage_lp_loans)

maxCostBps.description: Highest loan cost you accept, bps of the amount borrowed; refused above it

term.description: Loan term in seconds, one of gage_capabilities lpLane.terms

vault.description: The LP vault the new loan comes from; the loan's own vault first when omitted

name: gage_prepare_lp_roll
title: Prepare: Roll an LP loan over
